label: r1
issues: Reads as a lumpy brown blob, not a bat-like owl/monster at a glance
Wings are flat stud-up plate stacks sticking out sideways instead of angled scalloped bat wings
Extra pair of arm/wing stubs mid-body not in concept
Eyes misplaced (off-center, too high, uneven) and too small; tan ring look lost
Mouth is a dark slot tile instead of clean recessed rectangle
Ears are chunky angled bricks with exposed studs, not smooth pointed wedges
Body lacks smooth wood-texture panel faces; exposed studs and brick seams everywhere
Feet are bare brick stubs, missing the angled shoe plates
Clear stand is a bulky plate cluster rather than a slim display rod
Inconsistent brown tones (dark vs reddish) break colour blocking
distilled: A LEGO model of a chunky stylised wooden cricket-bat-like character with a long rectangular brick body, a carved face, and short stubby arms and legs, standing upright on a display stand.
